newsitem.title: PERU: Peru wholesale prices rise 1.20 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Peru wholesale prices rise 1.20 pct in October.

text.p: Peru's wholesale prices rose 1.20 percent in October, up from 0.60 percent in the same month last year and from 0.90 percent in September, the National Institute of Statistics and Information (INEI) said Monday.
In the first ten months of 1996, wholesale prices rose 9.70 percent, up from from 7.70 percent in the same period of 1996.
Wholesale prices rose 10.80 percent in the last 12 months up to September, the INEI added.
In 1995, cumulative inflation for wholesale prices was 8.8 percent, slowing from 10.5 percent the previous year.
Last week, the government announced consumer prices rose 0.73 percent in October, compared with a 0.5 percent rise in the same month last year and 0.32 percent in September.
Cumulative consumer inflation in the first ten months of 1996 was 9.99 percent, up from 8.3 percent in the same period last year.
